messages:
opsbot: ALARM: Streaming endpoint `stream.generate` p99 latency > 2200ms for last 5m (baseline ~280ms). Tripped SLO alert. :rotating_light:
opsbot: Related anomaly: increased tail stalls on long-context sessions; error rate stable. Suspected recent precision profile rollout to int8/fp8 variants.
oncall-alex: I'm on it. Paging team. Allocating incident priority P1.
emily-ml: confirming — we pushed a precision-profile rollout (int8 fastpath + kv-dequant tweak) 12:07 UTC (canary -> 25% traffic) for model lw-7b-v1.
devon-sre: rolling logs now. Seeing CPU spike on proxy and large queue depth on runtime workers that handle streaming frames. p95 up ~600ms, p99 exploded.
emia-typo: (ignore)
emily-ml: key telemetry: KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x for long contexts after the new quant layout — explains extra token work.
maria-support: any customer-facing impact? A few support tickets reporting slow streaming and timeouts for long chat sessions.
oncall-alex: Customers in EU region showing highest impact, likely routed to the canary pool.
devon-sre: Collecting traces:
```
trace_id=0x9f4e stream.generate request_id=98a3 session_len=4096 model=lw-7b-v1 variant=int8-fastpath
stage=kv-dequant step=lookup latency_ms=1400
stage=kv-dequant step=dequant latency_ms=1100
stage=kernel exec latency_ms=200
total_tokens=512 total_latency_ms=2800
```
emily-ml: That dequant step shouldn't be 1.1s. Initial microbenchmark passed on perf nodes, but we didn't cover 4k+ contexts in canary. Looks like dequant code path is O(seq_len) and we somehow regress with new buffer layout.
oncall-alex: Triage options:
- rollback rollout to previous precision profile for canary (immediate)
- throttle canary to 5% and expand fallback routing to fp32/quant-stable
- patch dequant hotpath (risky for live)
maria-support: Recommend rollback to reduce customer impact. We've got 7 tickets and NPS chat flagged.
devon-sre: Agreed. Initiating rollback for lw-7b-v1 precision-profile canary -> previous-stable.
deploy-bot: deploy request received: `rollback precision-profile lw-7b-v1 canary` by oncall-alex. ETA ~90s.
opsbot: Action: route 100% of canary traffic away from int8-fastpath variant while rollback completes.
emily-ml: I'll open a debug session to capture heap and codepath metrics. Also grabbing perf traces.
devon-sre: Post-rollback, verify p99. If still high, we'll route canary -> fp32 replica and disable streaming framing optimizations.
oncall-alex: rollback completed. Deploy logs:
```
[4081234569] start rollback precision-profile lw-7b-v1 canary
[4081234578] reconfigured routing, canary variant -> stable-quant
[4081234586] commit complete
```
opsbot: Monitor: p99 dropped from 2240ms -> 310ms over 4m. p95 back to ~270ms.
emily-ml: Good. But we still see a minority of long sessions that had mid-session stalls (client retries). Need customer-impact list.
maria-support: Tracking affected customers: org-182, org-241, org-9003. Escalating with mitigation notes and suggested rollback explanation.
oncall-alex: Postmortem action items:
- stopgap: limit canary sequence length to <=2048 for any new precision rollouts
- engineering: fix dequant hotpath and add perf test for 8k context and kv-dequant microbench
- release: update rollout runbook to include immediate throttling and length-based gating
- support: proactive outreach to impacted customers + credit offer
emily-ml: I'll create PRs for the dequant fix and perf test; label urgent. Also will add telemetry alert for KV dequant latency > 200ms.
devon-sre: Confirming no error-rate regressions. We'll keep extra tracing on for 24h.
maria-support: Notifying CS and PMs. Drafting customer comms.
oncall-alex: Closing incident channel when all follow-ups are in ticketing. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
